verdict.rationale: three.js is fundamentally a 3D/WebGL/WebGPU rendering library; the evidence pack contains no mention of sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics, or any dedicated 2D-first workflow — only 3D scene/camera/renderer setup, TSL/WebGPU shaders, and general abstraction commentary. Nothing indicates 2D is treated as first-class rather than something achievable only via orthographic-camera workarounds.
